title: Repossession Assignment, Recall, Surrender and Notices — Kestrel Advantage Balloon
content:
**Assignment threshold.** A Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract may be assigned for repossession only when its days past due are at least the tier's assignment threshold.

**Right to cure.** Where the contract records a right-to-cure period greater than 0 days, assignment may occur only after a right-to-cure notice has been mailed and that many calendar days have run from the right-to-cure notice date.

**Recall.** While the account is assigned for repossession, the assignment is recalled when the customer pays all past-due installments and all late charges due in certified funds before the vehicle is recovered; a partial payment or a promise to pay does not recall it.

**Voluntary surrender.** A customer may voluntarily surrender the vehicle at any time while the contract is active; the surrender is the customer's own act, scheduled at a location the company designates, and the voluntary agency fee applies instead of the involuntary fee.

**Notices.** A notice can be mailed only while the contract status is active, assigned for repossession, repossessed, deficiency or paid in full. The notice of intent to sell is mailed within the tier's notice days in business days after the repossession date and states the scheduled sale date and the redemption and any reinstatement amount. A deficiency notice is mailed after a sale that leaves a balance and a surplus notice after a sale that leaves a surplus; mailing dates are recorded on the contract.

**Bankruptcy.** When the customer reports an active bankruptcy filing, or the bankruptcy status on the customer profile is not none, no collection or repossession step is taken by the servicing desk.

## Assignment test (hypothetical, threshold 75 days)

| Days past due | Right-to-cure period recorded | Notice mailed and period run | Assignment |
|---|---|---|---|
| 80 | 0 | — | Permitted |
| 80 | 20 days | Yes | Permitted |
| 80 | 20 days | Not yet run | Not permitted |
| 70 | 0 | — | Not permitted |

## Recall test

A payment of every past-due installment and every late charge due, in certified funds, before recovery recalls the assignment; the same payment by personal check, or a payment of only part of it, does not.
